name: com.drapnard.unitymeta
description: Metaprogramming/aspect authoring framework for Unity 2022.3 using IL post-processing and optional Roslyn tooling.

samples.description: Defines a custom field-set aspect with constant and dynamic bounds.
Defines a field-get aspect that transforms reads without mutating storage.
Defines a custom method aspect with before/after templates.
Defines a field-change aspect with old/new values and real-change filtering.
